integrity: Exact wall-word bijection, two rational generating function identities, elementary terminal-layer proof, and two standalone exhaustive comparison scripts with saved outputs. Finite tests do not substitute for infinite proof. No external independent mathematical review.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous binary three-site majority with exactly one pinned zero or, equivalently, a finite open line with zero-zero external boundary; t>=0 and n>=3. No classification of multiple pinned agents, biased initial laws, or stochastic/asynchronous dynamics. Qualitative fixed-only recurrence and sharp transient time were previously treated by Inokuchi and Sato (2000); asserted refinements are the entire time-resolved count and all-zero basin. First public date references the archived first version of Fukś (1997) on Rule 232, not publication of the present claim. Unindexed or inaccessible prior equivalents remain possible.
title: A Fibonacci consensus basin and exact relaxation shells in pinned majority dynamics
